summary.text: Channel 4 News is the news programme of the UK broadcaster Channel 4, produced by ITN. In March 2018 it broadcast a four-month undercover investigation into Cambridge Analytica and SCL Elections in which a reporter posed as a fixer for a prospective client; reports on 19 and 20 March 2018 showed executives discussing entrapment, bribery, proxy organisations and the firm's work for the Trump campaign. Cambridge Analytica suspended its chief executive Alexander Nix on 20 March 2018. The investigation won a Bafta for news coverage.

facts.claim: On 19 March 2018 Channel 4 News broadcast secretly filmed footage of Cambridge Analytica executives saying they could entrap politicians with bribes and Ukrainian sex workers; the meetings took place at London hotels between November 2017 and January 2018 with a reporter posing as a fixer for a wealthy client hoping to get candidates elected in Sri Lanka.
facts.quote: The meetings took place at London hotels over four months, between November 2017 and January 2018.

sources.title: Revealed: Trump's election consultants filmed saying they use bribes and sex workers to entrap politicians

facts.claim: On 20 March 2018 Channel 4 News broadcast footage in which Nix claimed the firm helped run Donald Trump's digital operation and described a self-destructing email system, and reported that the firm had suspended Nix pending a full investigation.
facts.quote: The firm announced it has suspended chief executive Alexander Nix, pending a full investigation.

sources.title: Exposed: Undercover secrets of Trump's data firm

facts.claim: Cambridge Analytica told Channel 4 News that it entirely refuted any allegation that it or its affiliates used entrapment, bribes or honey-traps, and that a strict firewall separated its activity from outside groups in the US election.
facts.quote: entirely refutes any allegation that Cambridge Analytica or any of its affiliates use entrapment, bribes, or so-called "honey-traps"

sources.title: Revealed: Trump's election consultants filmed saying they use bribes and sex workers to entrap politicians
Exposed: Undercover secrets of Trump's data firm

facts.claim: When Nix told MPs on 6 June 2018 that he had been tricked and that the footage was heavily edited, Channel 4 News said it rejected the claim.
facts.quote: Nix later said he was "tricked" into boasting to an undercover reporter.

sources.title: Reaction as former Cambridge Analytica CEO is grilled by MPs

facts.claim: Channel 4 News's Cambridge Analytica investigation was awarded a Bafta for news coverage.
facts.quote: The investigation has been awarded a Bafta for Best News Coverage.

sources.title: Channel 4 News wins Bafta for Cambridge Analytica investigation

facts.claim: Channel 4 News reported in 2018 on the Electoral Commission's findings against Vote Leave and Leave.EU, and in September 2019 on the NCA's conclusion that there was no evidence Leave.EU or Arron Banks had broken the law.
